title: Bounded driver wait at a QA stage
summary: At a scoped QA stage the deployment driver re-dispatches the stage in-process until QA settles or its timeout passes. The announcement names the poll cadence, a status-line cadence and the deadline; every four polls it prints elapsed time and the outstanding blocker count, so a silent capture means stuck. Each re-dispatch gets only the time left on that deadline; a dispatch still unanswered then ends the wait with the named timeout, exit 5 and the re-drive recovery. No other write gains a deadline.
